_comment: How an accessory is sized and placed for each socket type. head_top: headwear sits with its bottom a little above the brows, its crown (the narrowest slice of its lower half, above any brim) is a little wider than the head at that height, and anything wider than maxWidth head widths is pulled in toward the crown. A hat too shallow to cover the top of the head (with topClearance) grows until it does. A brief's "fit" replaces any of these, and its "scale" multiplies the size.

head_top.prompt: a single {description}, hat only, front view, seen slightly from above, centered, whole object visible
